retention_analysis:
Preserve all 243 source frames in order and exact motion phase from BG_01. Do not hold, average, anticipate, delay, repeat, delete, retime, interpolate, stabilize, reframe, crop or redesign movement. Prefer Video 1 geometry over any still whenever they disagree.

detailed_description:
Preserve the complete rounded film aperture shown in the pictures, with black outside it, and the rustic plaster-and-timber architecture supplied by the motion source. Preserve every visible person exactly as posed in the motion source. Render every frame with the pictures' look: correctly exposed black-and-white 16mm film with rich natural blacks, light grey textured plaster instead of blown-out white, highlights that roll off without clipping, and the same restrained fine grain and focus across people, walls, timber and ground. The washed-out, overexposed tonality of Video 1 is a transfer defect: do not reproduce it. Do not add scratches, dust, flicker or damage. Do not invent faces, props, people, text, color shifts or camera movement beyond what the source provides.
